column1: # PSP only text fixes. A row here wins over the synced PS2 text and over
# psp/tools/psp_supplement.tsv, and sync_text_from_ps2.py never touches this
# file, so a sync can never undo a PSP fix.
# One row per fix, five columns separated by TABs:
#   file      the PSP script number (as in the build's text folder, for
#             example 06470 or 01433), or * for every script
#   japanese  the Japanese record exactly as the PSP build extracts it
#   english   the English, one line per \n (a skit shows one line)
#   note      why the PSP needs its own wording
# Fix PS2 text in the PS2 folders and run the sync instead; this table is
# only for text that must differ on the PSP.
